subject: POC traffic profile finalization and evaluation timeline
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Park <amy@edgecommerce.com>, Sam Truong <sam.truong@edgecommerce.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + next steps for POC traffic profile

Thanks again for taking the demo call today — great conversation. Per our discussion, I wanted to summarize the immediate next steps so we have a single place to track acceptance criteria and who owns what. I attached a small sample of the traffic export and a draft mutual action plan.

Quick recap of the technical takeaways from your side:
- Primary use case: product recommendation API powering homepage, search, and promotional emails.
- Expected steady-state: ~60 RPS during business hours for homepage/search combined.
- Peak/burst profile: short spikes to ~450 RPS for 30–90s during campaign blasts (2–3x/day).
- Average prompt length: 120 tokens; median 95 tokens; 99th percentile ~420 tokens (includes browsing context).
- Concurrency: concurrent unique sessions ~300 active at peak; sustained concurrency for long-running sessions up to 60s.
- Savings opportunity: ~25–30% of requests are identical prefixes (title-only prompts) — caching could matter.

What we need from EdgeCommerce to finalize the POC scope (see attached edge-poc-workload.csv):
1) Confirm the three endpoints to test (homepage-recs, search-recs, email-gen) and provide the expected RPS split.
2) Confirm token distribution if you have more samples for 95/99 pctiles.
3) Indicate any legal/regulatory constraints on data retention for user prompts.
4) Preferred test window (we suggested Tuesday 04/20 09:00–12:00 PT in the MAP).

Deliverables Redwood will own:
- POC environment with identical model variant to hosted profile, pre-warmed KV cache. (Owner: Ben Carter)
- End-to-end instrumentation dashboard (latency by endpoint, per-token cost, error rate). (Owner: Rachel Kim)
- A short quality evaluation: 500 representative prompts, pass/fail criteria and manual review plan. (Owner: Mina Haddad)

Please confirm the items above and sign off on the attached mutual-action-plan-v1.docx if the scope looks correct. Once we have your confirmation we’ll lock the test window and provision reserved capacity for the run.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0164

Attachments: edge-poc-workload.csv, mutual-action-plan-v1.docx, traffic-sample.json

Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps for POC traffic profile

Thanks Mina — this is very helpful. A few clarifications from our side after sharing with the eng team:
- Endpoints to test: homepage-recs (60%), search-recs (30%), email-gen (10%). We can provide separate hostnames for each.
- Token distribution: I pulled a larger export and attached an anonymized sample (we cannot share PII). Median matches your numbers; 99th percentile we see ~480 tokens for some long-context flows (promotions + user history).
- Bursts: Campaign spikes are typically ~2 minutes, sometimes up to 4 minutes during flash promotions. Peak RPS has hit 520 historically, but that included retries — normal traffic peak we expect ~450.
- Data retention: we cannot persist raw prompts beyond 30 days; aggregated telemetry is fine.

We can confirm the test window proposed (Tue 04/20 09:00–12:00 PT) or move it to Wed 04/21 if you need more lead time. Attaching the anonymized token-sample.csv.

Let us know what you need from the infra side (IP allowlist, test tokens, endpoint secrets).

— Amy
Amy Park
Head of Data Platforms, EdgeCommerce
amy@edgecommerce.com

Attachments: token-sample.csv
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps for POC traffic profile

Appreciate the quick turn, Amy — that token sample is perfect. I updated the MAP with the revised peak/burst numbers and added two optional test scenarios:
A) Campaign spike (450 RPS sustained for ~90s, 4-minute tail)
B) Extended blast (peak to 520 RPS, 3 min, with 15% retry noise)

Changes in the attached MAP:
- Acceptance SLA: p99 latency < 450ms for homepage/search; p95 < 650ms for email-gen under test conditions.
- Quality gate: automatic pass if within 5% of baseline relevance score over the 500-sample set; otherwise manual review.
- Telemetry: full token-level histogram, per-model token cost, error classification.
- Provisioning: Redwood will stand up a dedicated pool for the POC with pre-warm — Ben will own scaling knobs and failover to fallback model variant.

Action items for EdgeCommerce before 04/20:
- Confirm final endpoint hostnames and return a small set (5) of test API keys we can map into the trial environment.
- Approve MAP or suggest edits by EOD Fri 04/16.

If agreeable, we’ll publish the probe schedule (ICS) and send the run-day playbook with escalation contacts. I attached the updated MAP and a calendar probe-schedule.

Mina
